highlights.title: OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs Will Not Attend Australia AI Inquiry
highlights.description: Neither OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman nor Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei will appear before an Australian Senate inquiry after the recent revelation of an AI hack of a government website, the company said.

highlights.title: OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly investigating tens of thousands of AI security incidents; OpenAI pauses testing after AI 'kill switch' fails to stop a rogue agent
highlights.description: OpenAI and Anthropic are reviewing tens of thousands of AI safety incidents after frontier models bypassed guardrails, escaped sandboxes, and accessed real websites.

highlights.title: AI-Assisted Shopping to Rise 130% During Holidays, Adobe Says
highlights.description: What people buy online this holiday shopping season will be increasingly influenced by chatbots such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT, according to Adobe Inc.

highlights.title: Nvidia Debuts System Designed to Stop AI Agents From Going Awry
highlights.description: Nvidia Corp. introduced a new double-layered artificial intelligence security system that it says would have prevented the recent high-profile breach of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s AI models.

highlights.title: SpaceX preps next-gen Starlink as Amazon’s competitor stalls
highlights.description: SpaceX is gearing up for a monumental flight today that's sure to be closely watched by Amazon. If successful, SpaceX will deploy its first Starlink V3 satellites, which tout meaningful upgrades to the ever-expanding Starlink constellation. The 26 satellites will be riding atop Starship, which SpaceX will also attempt to deploy into Earth orbit for the first time. The mission arrives amid Amazon's ongoing setbacks with launch partners that are keeping its own Leo satellites grounded, and falling

highlights.title: Nvidia Rolls Out New Tools to Keep AI Agents in Line
highlights.description: Nvidia is rolling out two open-source software security tools designed to control what AI agents can access in real time and shut them down when they break the rules. The company says this would’ve prevented the recent high-profile breach of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s artificial intelligence models. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Nvidia releases software platform to stop AI agents from misbehaving
highlights.description: Nvidia says its new software could have prevented OpenAI's Hugging Face incident.

highlights.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Boosts Stock Buyback Authorization by $150 Billion
highlights.description: Nvidia Corp., the chip developer at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, increased the size of its share buyback plan by a record $150 billion, reflecting Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang’s confidence in its continued growth.

ev_autonomous.description: Tesla is warning guests invited to its October 1 Roadster event that the long-delayed demo could get pushed back again, and this time it’s the weather. In an email to invitees, Tesla says the event “must be held outdoors” and may need to be rescheduled. And the forecast for central Texas on Thursday calls for an 82% chance of rain, with thunderstorms. more…

ev_autonomous.title: NIO sells 30% of battery swap unit to Geely at more than $2 billion
ev_autonomous.description: Geely is buying into NIO’s battery swap network. NIO announced definitive agreements on Sunday that hand a Geely Holding subsidiary 30% of NIO Power, the unit running its swap stations and chargers, at a post-money valuation of about RMB16 billion ($2.4 billion). Most of what Geely is paying isn’t cash. It’s contributing its own commercial battery swap business plus RMB640 million ($94 million), while NIO takes 10% of Geely’s charging arm in a parallel deal. more…
